1935, March
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 321 Cont.
Mar. 26 Theresa Murphy - 49 - stroke Saturd'y 24th. Given an hour to live - was enrolled 24 hours later. To-night 48 hrs. after reported steadily improving. All went to holy Communion this a.m.
Aug. 20. Mrs. M. at Monaster'y To-day - heart & blood p. normal - live at 7761 Dunedin
9 o'cl. June Knapp - 5 - double mastoid operation To-night - 7 a.m. so far successful
Rev. Ray Mackinnon - Cincinnatti, 0. - to be ordained June 9th - appendicitis; Mother went down last night.
Page 322 Page 323
Blank Page
Mar. 27 Mary Marg. Donavan - 62 - complication - fear of loss of sight. Stanley Gielephen - 13 - convulsion Mary Raber - 49 - operation Saturday
1935, April
April Apr. 3
Edward Collins - 12 - blood cancer cured but leg badly broken etc June Knapp -5 - double mastoid operation ..... April 26 ... slowly ... Aloysius Coscimuski - 23 - Sister superior's nephew- in undesirable company
Mrs. Ann McCarthy - 42 - fearful pains Rev. R. McKannon deacon - last week was .... Drs. have no hope ... Mrs. Matilda Kosecke - 71 - Enemic Wm. Grogan - in Providence - 67 - fears groth on kidney and opera- tion.
Marie Gildow - 24 - mental - brother out of work.
Page 324 Blank Page
